title.source_quote:
国务院关于深入实施“人工智能+”行动的意见
国发〔2025〕11号
title.why: Literally 'State Council opinions on deeply implementing the "AI+" action'. 'Deepening the Implementation' is the usual rendering of 深入实施, and 'AI+' keeps the original's symbol (also rendered 'AI Plus' or 'Artificial Intelligence+'). original_title matches the source character for character, including the curly quotation marks.

summary_claims.claim: a dedicated section on improving security capabilities: security across models and algorithms, data, infrastructure and applications; tackling opacity, hallucination and algorithmic discrimination; forward-looking risk assessment; and technical monitoring, early warning and emergency response
summary_claims.original_quote: （十四）提升安全能力水平。推动模型算法、数据资源、基础设施、应用系统等安全能力建设，防范模型的黑箱、幻觉、算法歧视等带来的风险，加强前瞻评估和监测处置，推动人工智能应用合规、透明、可信赖。建立健全人工智能技术监测、风险预警、应急响应体系，强化政府引导、行业自律，坚持包容审慎、分类分级，加快形成动态敏捷、多元协同的人工智能治理格局。
summary_claims.literal_translation: (14) Raise the level of security capability. Promote the building of security capabilities for model algorithms, data resources, infrastructure, application systems and so on; guard against risks brought by model black boxes, hallucinations, algorithmic discrimination and so on; strengthen forward-looking assessment and monitoring and handling; promote AI applications that are compliant, transparent and trustworthy. Establish and improve systems for AI technology monitoring, risk early warning and emergency response; strengthen government guidance and industry self-discipline; adhere to an inclusive and prudent, categorised and graded approach; speed up forming a dynamic, agile, multi-party collaborative AI governance pattern.

summary_claims.claim: calls for advancing AI legislation and ethics norms and improving security assessment and filing
summary_claims.original_quote: 完善人工智能法律法规、伦理准则等，推进人工智能健康发展相关立法工作。优化人工智能相关安全评估和备案管理制度。
summary_claims.literal_translation: Improve AI laws and regulations, ethical norms and so on, and advance legislative work related to the healthy development of AI. Optimise the AI-related security assessment and filing management system.

summary_claims.claim: focused mainly on deploying AI across industry, consumption, public services and science
summary_claims.original_quote: 以科技、产业、消费、民生、治理、全球合作等领域为重点
summary_claims.literal_translation: taking science and technology, industry, consumption, people's livelihood, governance, global cooperation and other fields as the focus

key_terms.note: No official English version found. 'AI Plus' and 'Artificial Intelligence+' Initiative also circulate; 'AI+' is faithful to the original symbol.
安全 covers both safety and security; the section mixes both (hallucination, discrimination as well as infrastructure security), so 'security' is defensible but narrower than the Chinese.

key_terms.original: 安全评估和备案管理制度
key_terms.note: Refers to the existing CAC assessment and algorithm/model filing regime; the text says 优化 (optimise), the register says 'improving'.

issues: scope_note says safety is 'about one-fifth' of the text (sections 13 and 14); in the stored text those two items are about 330 of about 4,900 characters of body text (roughly 7 percent), and item 13 is mostly about state-capital oversight, finance and fiscal support, with only two sentences on law, ethics and security assessment.
notes give publication as 27 Aug 2025, which is the CAC re-post date; the stored MIIT copy, also sourced from gov.cn, is timed 2025-08-26 17:57, so gov.cn published it by 26 Aug 2025.

Summary names four focus areas (industry, consumption, public services, science); the text names six (科技、产业、消费、民生、治理、全球合作), omitting governance and global cooperation, and 民生 is people's livelihood (jobs, education, health, culture) rather than 'public services'.
note: The safety content of the summary (items 13 and 14) is rendered accurately. The text also asks to jointly assess and respond to AI application risks and keep AI development safe, reliable and controllable (item （六）2) and to assess employment risks of AI (item （四）1), which the summary does not mention. 'China's current flagship AI policy' is an evaluation that the text does not state.
